title: useCounter Hook
description:
Implement a `useCounter` hook that returns `{ count, increment, decrement, reset }`. The counter starts at the provided `initialValue` (default `0`).

**Example:**
```tsx
const { count, increment, decrement, reset } = useCounter(10);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using setCount(count + 1) instead of the functional updater setCount(c => c + 1), which causes stale closure bugs when multiple updates fire rapidly.
